title: fx-rates/1
description: Dated exchange rates. Owner: assets. Every cross-currency figure in every report names the rate and its date — there is no implicit conversion anywhere in the system (ADR-0005).

pair.description: Base then quote, e.g. USDZAR means 1 USD in ZAR.

rate_source.description: Where the rate came from — public reference data, the one class of outbound lookup the redaction hook permits. NOT named 'source': that name belongs to the envelope's provenance block, and redefining it here would make the schema unsatisfiable.
